overview.description: The John Hancock U.S. High Dividend ETF (JHDV) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high dividend yield equity. The fund is an actively managed fund of high dividend-paying or high dividend growth stocks. Selection and weighting are based on a proprietary systematic approach of US large- and mid-cap companies. JHDV was launched on Sep 27, 2022 and is issued by John Hancock.
